description: This file defines the SearchController class for Drupal's search module, handling search page rendering, search operations, and related actions.

classes.name: SearchController
classes.description: Controller class for handling search page rendering, search operations, and related actions in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SearchController with dependencies: search page repository and renderer.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Creates a render array for displaying the search page, including form and results, based on the request and search entity.

methods.name: searchHelp
methods.description: Returns a render array with help information for the search page.

methods.name: redirectSearchPage
methods.description: Redirects to the default search page.

methods.name: editTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for editing a search page.

methods.name: performOperation
methods.description: Performs enable/disable operations on a search page and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: setAsDefault
methods.description: Sets a specific search page as the default and redirects to search page collection.
